matches.preview: Manchester City is the clear model favourite at 58 per cent. The head-to-head record demonstrates City's consistent strength in this fixture. A draw at 24 per cent is possible though less likely than a City win. The model leans toward over 2.5 goals at 56 per cent, suggesting this encounter may feature attacking play from both sides.

The model favours Liverpool at 62%, though this fixture's recent history suggests a competitive encounter. Last season, Liverpool finished with mixed form including losses and draws, while Nottingham Forest showed stronger results. The head-to-head record is closely matched, featuring Forest's 3-0 victory at this ground during the last campaign alongside Liverpool's more recent 1-0 home win. The model indicates over 2.5 goals at 59%.
matches.preview_zh: 模型看好Liverpool勝率為62%，儘管這場對賽的近期歷史表明將是場競爭激烈的比賽。上個賽季，Liverpool戰績參差不齊，包括敗績和平手，而Nottingham Forest表現更為強勢。交手紀錄勢均力敵，其中包括Forest在本地以3-0獲勝，以及Liverpool最近的1-0主場勝利。模型顯示超過2.5球的概率為59%。

matches.preview: Bournemouth are slight favourites at 48%, with Everton at 25% and a draw at 26%, suggesting a competitive match. The hosts have dominated recent head-to-head encounters, winning four of their last five meetings with the visitors. Both sides return from the off-season following mixed finishes to last year: Bournemouth closed with back-to-back draws, whilst Everton took just two points from their final six matches. The total-goals model leans marginally towards over 2.5, at 51%.
matches.preview_zh: Bournemouth 略為領先，佔48%，Everton 佔25%，平手佔26%，暗示這將是一場競爭激烈的比賽。主隊在最近的交手中居於優勢地位，在過去五場交手中贏了四場。兩隊從賽季休整回歸，在去年的比賽結束時成績各異：Bournemouth 以連續平手作結，而 Everton 在最後六場比賽中僅獲得兩分。進球總數模型略微傾向於超過2.5，佔51%。

matches.preview: Coventry are the model's clear preference at 56%, with Hull assessed at 20%. The teams have drawn goalless in their two most recent meetings, both from the end of last season. Coventry showed strong form across their final six fixtures with three wins and three draws, including victories over Watford, Wrexham and Portsmouth. Hull proved less consistent in that same period, managing one win alongside two defeats across six matches. The model favours goals slightly, with over 2.5 at 54%.
matches.preview_zh: 模型明確傾向Coventry，概率為56%；Hull評估為20%。兩隊在最近兩次交手中都以0:0打成平手，均為上賽季末的比賽。Coventry在最後六場比賽中表現強勁，取得三場勝利和三場平手，包括戰勝Watford、Wrexham和Portsmouth。Hull在同期表現較為不穩定，六場比賽中僅得一場勝利和兩場敗績。模型輕微傾向進球較多，over 2.5的概率為54%。

matches.preview: The model backs Tottenham at 42%, though Newcastle's 32% win probability is close enough to indicate a fairly balanced contest, with a 26% draw likelihood. Newcastle's head-to-head records strongly favour them, having won three of the last five meetings, including a notable 4-0 victory. The model favours an open match, with 57% probability of exceeding 2.5 goals.
matches.preview_zh: 模型看好Tottenham的勝率為42%，但Newcastle的32%勝率足夠接近，表明這場對陣相當均衡，平手的可能性為26%。上賽季Tottenham在六場比賽中贏了三場，其中包括對Chelsea的一次敗仗，而Newcastle則在六場中僅贏了兩場。Newcastle與Tottenham的交戰紀錄大幅有利於Newcastle，過去五場交手中Newcastle贏了三場，其中包括一場值得注目的4-0勝利。模型看好這會是一場開放式比賽，進球數超過2.5的機率為57%。

matches.preview: The model favours Leeds marginally at 37% versus Brentford's 36%, with a draw at 27%, making this finely balanced. From previous season form, Leeds showed strength at home, recording three consecutive victories there, whilst Brentford demonstrated weakness away from home. The recent head-to-head record reinforces the defensive nature of this fixture, with the last two meetings producing just two goals between them. The total-goals market is split at 51% for over 2.5 versus 49% for under, reflecting the balance in attacking potential.
matches.preview_zh: 模型輕微看好Leeds，得分為37%，相比Brentford的36%，平局概率為27%，整體局勢平衡緊湊。從上一賽季的表現來看，Leeds展現出強大的主場實力，在主場錄得三場連勝，而Brentford則在客場表現較弱。最近的交手紀錄進一步印證了這場比賽的防守導向特性，過去兩次交手總共僅進2球。進球數預測方面，2.5球以上與以下基本平分，分別為51%與49%，反映出雙方進攻火力的均衡。

matches.preview: This match looks finely balanced by the model's assessment: Chelsea are rated at 43% to win, Brighton at 30%, with the draw rated at 27%. Brighton's recent dominance in this fixture is clear: a 3-0 win at home in April this year and a 3-1 victory away in September 2025. Chelsea's last success, a 4-2 win in September 2024, now feels remote. Both sides ended last season with distinctly inconsistent results, mixing emphatic wins with heavy defeats. The model leans slightly towards over 2.5 goals at 55%, suggesting an open encounter.
matches.preview_zh: 根據模型評估，這場比賽看起來勢均力敵：Chelsea 的勝率為 43%，Brighton 為 30%，平局為 27%。Brighton 最近在對陣中的優勢明顯：今年 4 月主場 3:0 勝利，以及 2025 年 9 月客場 3:1 勝利。Chelsea 最後一次勝利是 2024 年 9 月的 4:2，現在感覺很遙遠。兩隊上賽季結束時表現明顯不穩定，既有令人印象深刻的勝利，也有慘敗。模型略微傾向於總進球數超過 2.5 球，可能性為 55%，預示這將是場較為開放的比賽。

matches.preview: Fulham holds a slight edge in a competitive fixture, with the model projecting a 37% win probability against Sunderland's 34%. matches.preview_zh: Fulham在這場勢均力敵的比賽中略佔優勢，模型預測其勝率為37%，對陣Sunderland的34%。在最近的對戰紀錄中，Fulham在上個賽季的兩場對陣中都獲勝。雙方的近期戰績資料來自上個賽季末，因此對當前球隊狀態的洞察有限。模型傾向2.5球以下結果，概率為55%，暗示這將是一場競爭激烈、進球數少的比賽，可能以微弱差距決出勝負。

Chelsea's closing form was poor, producing just one win and one draw from six matches.
